items.excerpt: One of Schenectady's most recognizable landmarks has been lit up for the holiday season once again, following a hiatus in 2025 for refurbishments. On Friday evening, the historical General Electric logo atop GE's Schenectady building changed to red and green.

items.headline: Angel Tree Prison Fellowship Program helping those incarcerated over the holidays
items.excerpt: What does it mean to be incarcerated when you have kids at home? NEWS10's Valerie Wencis spoke to a formerly incarcerated mother of two who gave a firsthand look at a special program that makes sure Santa comes to those with parents in prison.

items.headline: Downtown Schenectady grocery store to open spring 2027
items.excerpt: Residents of downtown Schenectady have been living in what's called a "food desert" for more than a decade, traveling outside their neighborhoods for reliable groceries. Now the Electric City Community Grocery is set to open this spring after a groundbreaking on Friday morning.

items.headline: Hochul vetoes food chemical disclosures, bans
items.excerpt: New York State Governor Kathy Hochul vetoed the Food Safety and Chemical Disclosure Act on Friday, blocking legislation that would have banned three food additives and required companies to disclose safety data.
